info.name: ScaleSerum - Script Lab Creative Coach
info.description:
The Creative Coach panel on Script Lab.

Every saved example here was CAPTURED FROM THE RUNNING SERVICE, and every request carries assertions, so this collection is a gate rather than a document:

    newman run postman/ScaleSerum-ScriptLabCoach.postman_collection.json \
      --env-var baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:3011 --env-var apiKey=$API_KEY

SETUP
1. PORT=3011 python app.py
2. Set {{apiKey}} to API_KEY from .env.
3. Run the folder in order: requests 21-24 rate the turn created by 4-14, via the {{lastRequestId}} variable.

Requests 8-14 are the DEGRADED paths - no earlier version, ROAS that cannot exist, off-topic, no Brand Brain, a review that never completed, a script never published, Hinglish. A coach that only handles 4-7 is not finished. The contract lives in SCRIPT_LAB_COACH_API.md.

variable.description: PASTE YOUR KEY HERE. Value of API_KEY in .env.
